t: The Robus EBLANA LED emergency bulkhead provides reliable safety lighting for various applications. This rectangular, IP65-rated fitting is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making it ideal for commercial buildings, workshops, and residential common areas. It offers maintained or non-maintained operation, ensuring 3 hours of emergency illumination from its rechargeable battery pack. The 3.3W LED delivers 160 lumens of cool white light, and its compact, weatherproof polycarbonate body ensures durability and a discreet appearance.
